summary: Uno Platform ReactiveUI integration with startup-window-aware initialization and WASM-specific scheduler considerations.
recommendedPatterns: Use the Uno-specific ReactiveUI builder integration and pass the startup window where required.
Keep platform-specific initialization separate from generic desktop assumptions.
avoidPatterns: Do not ignore Uno startup window requirements.
Do not assume desktop thread pool behavior in WASM builds.
setupSteps: Initialize ReactiveUI through the Uno builder extension.
Validate behavior on both native and WASM targets.

options: ReactiveUI.Uno lean or ReactiveUI.Uno.Reactive compatibility package
Full WithUno registration or scheduler-only setup
Desktop, browser, Windows, Android, or iOS target
packageSelection: Install ReactiveUI.Uno for new Primitives-based Uno apps/libraries.
Install ReactiveUI.Uno.Reactive—not both—when existing public APIs require System.Reactive Unit/IScheduler/operators.
sourceGeneratorGuidance: Use ReactiveUI.SourceGenerators for Uno view-model state, commands, IViewFor, and registration where supported.
Use compile-time binding generation for static property paths before runtime expression binding.
compatibilityNotes: Lean namespaces use ReactiveUI.Uno and Primitives RxVoid/ISequencer; compatibility namespaces use ReactiveUI.Uno.Reactive and System.Reactive types.
Browser targets use the matching ReactiveUI.Primitives.Blazor sequencer package.
migrationGuidance: Choose one distribution for the host; move lean code to WithUno plus RxVoid/ISequencer and Signal types.
Use ReactiveUI.Uno.Reactive as a deliberate compatibility boundary when source/public API changes cannot be made immediately.
